name: ArrTags
description: ArrTags reads metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publishes configurable badges (for example the actual file quality) onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs, preserving the original poster. It is configured from a dashboard settings page that applies most changes to the running plugin without a restart, supports a per-selector value allowlist and configurable badge size and position (including Extra Large), shows byte-denominated limits in a fixed binary unit (MB, or KB for the webhook payload) while the saved value stays the exact byte count, marks the restart-required settings, bounds log verbosity with a secret-redaction contract, and caches each provider library so one read serves a reconciliation window. The same page shows a read-only, administrator-only diagnostics panel with bounded counters for the current Jellyfin session, and scheduled and post-scan reconciliation covers a library larger than the work queue across successive runs.
overview: Adds dashboard-configurable Sonarr and Radarr metadata badges to Jellyfin posters, with a read-only diagnostics panel.

versions.changelog: v1.2 shows byte-denominated limits in binary units (MB, or KB for the webhook payload) with the exact byte count persisted and off-step values rejected, adds restart-required note text plus a best-effort change reminder for the settings that need a host restart (a mixed setting states that some paths apply immediately), adds the Extra Large badge size (dropdown order Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large), identifies media in log output by a bounded file name (with an item-id fallback, never a directory or full path) together with the bounded render classification, adds a read-only administrator diagnostics panel backed by a bounded, secret-free status endpoint, covers a library larger than the work queue across successive scheduled and post-scan reconciliation runs through a persisted cursor, re-enqueues the post-save re-render of an item whose older-version work was discarded instead of dropping it, and restores the original poster when a saved configuration narrows an owned item's badge selection to empty. ArrTags continues to read metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publish configurable badges onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs while preserving the original poster.

v1.1 adds a dashboard settings page that validates and applies most configuration changes to the running plugin without a host restart (an invalid change is rejected with the last valid configuration retained and recorded as a bounded, secret-free activity-log entry), a per-selector badge value allowlist, configurable badge size and position, bounded configurable log verbosity with a secret-redaction contract, and a bounded provider inventory cache that serves one library read per connection per reconciliation window with ArrTags-side invalidation. ArrTags continues to read metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publish configurable badges onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs while preserving the original poster.

Initial release. ArrTags reads metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publishes configurable badges (for example the actual file quality) onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs, preserving the original poster.
